biography.plain_text: Sergio De Matteis is an Italian plastics entrepreneur and the founder of Polycar. After years of working in the plastics trade, he established Polycar Srl in 1987. Its expansion reached Mexico, where it manufactured household and garden furniture, and Belgium, where a subsidiary processed semi-finished plastic materials for industrial use.

long_biography.plain_text:
At Polycar, Sergio De Matteis built a business around giving discarded plastic a second industrial use. Production scraps are selected, blended to customers’ specifications, melted and filtered before being made into granules. The resulting materials are tailored for properties such as strength and resistance to impact, allowing manufacturers to use them in new products.

The company also established a research partnership with the University of Perugia’s civil and environmental engineering department. Signed by company administrator Carlo De Matteis in 2022, the agreement covered plastics recycling, polymers and biopolymers, and environmental protection.
